working: This uses the NCERT significant-figure rule: when the digit dropped is exactly 5, leave the preceding digit unchanged if it is even, and increase it by 1 if it is odd. For 17.0145, the digit before the dropped 5 is 4, which is even, so it stays: 17.014. For 21.0235, the digit before the dropped 5 is 3, which is odd, so it becomes 4: 21.024.
